35: func (c *TerminalChannel) Send(ctx context.Context, msg bus.OutboundMessage) error {
36: 	// Find all PTYs
37: 	entries, err := os.ReadDir("/dev/pts")
38: 	if err != nil {
39: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read /dev/pts: %w", err)
40: 	}
41: 
42: 	formattedMsg := fmt.Sprintf("\r\n\x1b[32m[KNIRVAGENT] %s\x1b[0m\r\n", msg.Content)
43: 
44: 	for _, entry := range entries {
45: 		// Only write to numbered PTYs (e.g., /dev/pts/0)
46: 		name := entry.Name()
47: 		if name == "ptmx" || name == "terminal" {
48: 			continue
49: 		}
50: 
51: 		path := filepath.Join("/dev/pts", name)
52: 		f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0)
53: 		if err != nil {
54: 			// Skip PTYs we can't open
55: 			continue
56: 		}
57: 		
58: 		_, _ = f.WriteString(formattedMsg)
59: 		_ = f.Close()
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	return nil
63: }
